title: Image-only CMS adapters place sourced photos through native contract shapes and preserve editor/revision fences
steps: S1: an opportunity-built EmDash site with own photos is applied.
S2: a site with no own photos.
S3: run the image-only adapter with a suitable photograph beyond the first 24; replay after success, after a known draft, and after a published gallery readback failure.
S4: clear an image as an editor, change its schema, lose a PUT response after commit, hide a parent page, and simulate a prose writer clearing the image.
S5: inspect the WordPress contract as native keyed slot values, then replace a real photo; simulate an editor change before upload and between upload and contract write.
expect: S1: both runs get --no-images and no image key.
S3: sourced media is uploaded and read back; text stays unchanged; replay does not upload again or repeat an acknowledged publication.
S4: editor changes and unknown mutations fail closed; hidden detail routes are excluded; a later prose image change cannot pass verification.
S5: the keyed WordPress inspection writes only image slots and verifies readback; both editor changes refuse replacement.

selectors.code: sites/brief-engines/emdash.js realPictures, app.js createSitePictures for EmDash

evidence: Review 19/10/2026: WordPress/Joomla stopped drawing when the place had photos; EmDash did not
fence: EmDash follows the same real-photos rule

tests: an opportunity-built EmDash site with the restaurant’s own photographs draws no picture, in the warm-up nor on the site
a site with no photographs of its own — none collected, not an opportunity’s, or a reader that fails — draws as before
a real photo beyond the first 24 is eligible, without a text plan or a model call
an editor clearing an image before a retry is never filled back in
a lost PUT response is uncertain and cannot be adopted as an owned draft
a published gallery receipt reconciles generated row UUIDs after a failed readback
the final read-only fence rejects images replaced by a later prose writer
wordpress: image-only phase uses shared selection/crop and writes no text
wordpress: an editor change refuses image replacement before upload
wordpress: changes between upload and contract write are not a new baseline
